name: Trigger: OnFirstWindowOpen
purpose: File-open trigger: makes sure the singleton meta record exists (creates one when the meta table is empty), then returns to the original layout.
writes: meta: new record (New Record/Request step 14, when TotalRecordCount = 0)
open_question: Creates the file's meta row (holds FileVersion). In the target this is configuration seed data.

name: Trigger: OnCloseLastWindow
purpose: Last-window-close trigger: when the file is not hosted (multi-user state not 2), clears the meta utility global, sets multi-user hidden, resets the toolbar, menu bar and window size.

name: Save As Clone ( Path )
purpose: Developer helper that saves a clone (no records) of this file to the folder given in the parameter. Effect owner would be none (build tooling).
callers: none found (may be called by name)
external: Save a Copy as (clone, step 5, file system)

name: Use Local Data File
purpose: Developer helper that sets $$UseOpenDatFile and runs the OnFirstWindowOpen trigger. Effect owner would be client-ui.
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: $$UseOpenDatFile is read elsewhere (not in this share); see callers column.

name: Commander
purpose: Developer remote-control script called by URL from the developer utility file (or by Perform Script with Let notation): opens Manage Database, Scripts or Layouts, brings the window to front, hides it, resets an account password, deletes an account, deactivates an account, or returns the file version. Effect owner would be server-domain for account administration, but the target replaces account management.
writes: none (account changes are made by Reset Account Password, Delete Account and Enable Account steps; the target is chosen by $AccountName at run time)
callers: none found (may be called by name)
external:
Reset Account Password (step 20)
Delete Account (step 22)
Enable Account (Deactivate, step 24)
Open Manage Database / Script Workspace / Manage Layouts (steps 10-14)
Evaluate of the script parameter (step 6)
open_question: secret: step 20 sets an account password from $NewPassword. The "DisableAccount" command calls Enable Account with Deactivate. Evaluate on the script parameter runs arbitrary expressions, so the entry point must not be exposed in the target.

name: Re-login { data }
purpose: Re-authenticates the current file session with the account name and password passed in (called by Karbon after login) without a dialog, which switches the session to that account and its privileges.
open_question: secret: step 5 sends accountPassword. The FileMaker account/privilege model is replaced by the target auth; the privilege sets are covered by the security explorer.

name: Perform Script By Name
purpose: Runs a script by name with a parameter, both taken from the JSON parameter. Returns the JSON error if the parameter is not valid JSON; does nothing when the name is empty.
writes: none (the called script is chosen at run time)
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: The target scripts depend on what callers pass in; check the callers column and search for the text "Perform Script By Name" in other files.
